name: MinIO
description: S3-compatible object storage with a web console on port 9001. Set a strong root password before deploy.

ru.description: S3-совместимое объектное хранилище с веб-консолью на порту 9001. Задайте надёжный root-пароль перед деплоем.

composeYaml:
services:
  minio:
    image: minio/minio:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: server /data --console-address ":9001"
    ports:
      - "9000:9000"
      - "9001:9001"
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: ${MINIO_ROOT_USER:-minioadmin}
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - data:/data
volumes:
  data:
